description: dotnet new templates for an ASP.NET Core 10 Enterprise Modular Monolith: Clean Architecture modules (Domain/Application/Infrastructure) with layering and isolation enforced by NetArchTest architecture tests, CQRS, Wolverine + RabbitMQ & Kafka service bus, Marten event sourcing on PostgreSQL, EF Core, OpenIddict PKCE/OAuth2 with 2FA/impersonation/multi-tenancy, an Angular SPA and a full test suite. Multi-tenancy, RabbitMQ, Kafka, the Angular UI and the provider-adapter example are each optional via dotnet-new flags. Includes 'enterprise-modular' (full solution) and 'enterprise-modular-module' (add and wire a new module).
title: Enterprise Modular Monolith Templates
